author: Antigravity
description: A Pattern Recognition system based on the 'Journey Framework'. It identifies 26 unique semantic profiles that have historically led to rallies with 0% failure rate.

rule_logic: Semantic Profile Matching (Phase|Tension|Harmony|Rhythm|Context). Rejects any profile with a history of failure.
discovery_notes: Replaced 'Midnight Sniper' (1 hit) with 'Journey Framework' (38 hits).

Philosophy: 'Recognition, not Rules'. Eliminates any profile that ever failed.
